entries.text: Save the doc as a .md file

Sometimes you want the source, not the finished page. File › Export › Markdown saves the document as a .md file straight to your downloads folder. Useful for a git repository, another Markdown editor, or an archive.

entries.caption: The topbar menu opens, Export sits in the file actions.
Your browser saves the file, named after the document.
The saved file is plain Markdown: headings, lists and links as you wrote them. A short block at the top keeps the theme and the document settings for a later import.

next.why: Or download a styled PDF instead, same File menu, different format
